ui.title: ATO Avatar Texture Optimizer
ui.generateAtlas.tip: Repack UV islands into atlases. When off: only whole-texture scaling + parameter optimization (no UV changes).
ui.dedupTextures.tip: Merge textures identical in pixels AND import settings, then update references.
ui.dedupMaterials.tip: Merge materials identical in content & parameters (opaque slot merge updates animations).
ui.whitelist.tip: All textures referenced by these objects (any type: mesh/material/texture/animation/...) skip ALL optimization. Textures sharing their UV skip atlasing but still get whole-image scaling.
ui.preset.tip: Presets overwrite parameter values. Editing any parameter switches to Custom; Custom params are never overwritten.
ui.npot.tip: Candidate atlas resolutions step by 64px instead of powers of two. Verified to support Mip Streaming & Crunch. Unsupported formats (e.g. PVRTC on iOS) are removed.
cat.mips.tip: One switch for both: VRChat requires Mip Streaming when Mipmaps are on.
q.nearLosslessNote: Custom defaults are near-lossless (= preset value 1).
pl.title: Platform override (affects format limits etc.)
report.title: ATO Optimization Report
report.noAtlasMode: Atlas generation disabled - whole-texture scaling only
report.cancelled: Bake cancelled by user; temporary assets kept, CPU/GPU/memory released.
warn.crossSeam: Texture '{0}' UVs are out of range and cross a wrap seam; skipped atlas optimization.
warn.oversize: Texture '{0}' cannot fit into the largest atlas even alone; fell back to whole-texture scaling.
warn.unknownShader: Shader '{0}' could not be analyzed; its textures are treated as whitelisted.
warn.grayMultiChannel: Grayscale texture '{0}' uses multiple channels; saved as multi-channel despite single-channel format.
warn.formatUnsafe: Format '{0}' unsafe for '{1}' (has alpha); fell back to a safe format.
warn.noAtlasing: Texture '{0}' shares UVs with a non-atlased texture; whole-image scaling only.
warn.aaoEvacuate: Failed to evacuate original UVs for AAO compatibility on '{0}': {1}
warn.stAnimated: Texture transform of '{0}' is animated; treated as whitelisted.
warn.npotFormat: Format {0} does not support NPOT; removed from candidates.
